title: A Nonconvex Framework for Joint Sparse Sample Weighting and Parameter Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33957v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose a joint sparse sample weighting and parameter estimation (SWAPE) framework that jointly optimizes model parameters and sample weights to train a model while simultaneously assigning an individual weight to each training data point. Our framework accommodates several widely used loss functions for the model parameters, including convex, weakly convex, and difference-of-convex loss, and weakly convex sparsity functions to control the complexity of the sample weights. To solve the resulting bivariate problem, we propose an alternating minimization method in which the subproblems for updating the model parameters and weights are each approximated using majorize-minimize techniques. We provide several approximation methods for the loss functions considered in this paper, and show the overall algorithm's convergence. Numerical experiments on various learning tasks and data anomaly settings demonstrate the effectiveness of the prop

translated_title: 一种用于联合稀疏样本加权与参数估计的非凸框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种联合稀疏样本加权与参数估计（SWAPE）框架，该框架联合优化模型参数和样本权重，在训练模型的同时为每个训练数据点分配单独的权重。我们的框架适用于多种广泛使用的模型参数损失函数，包括凸、弱凸和凸差损失，以及用于控制样本权重复杂度的弱凸稀疏函数。为了求解由此产生的二元问题，我们提出了一种交替最小化方法，其中更新模型参数和权重的子问题各自使用主化-最小化技术进行近似。我们为本文考虑的损失函数提供了几种近似方法，并证明了整体算法的收敛性。在各种学习任务和数据异常设置上的数值实验证明了所提出框架的有效性。
tldr: 提出了一种联合稀疏样本加权与参数估计（SWAPE）的非凸框架，通过交替最小化和主化-最小化近似技术同时优化模型参数与每个样本的稀疏权重，并证明了算法的收敛性。
en_tdlr: A nonconvex SWAPE framework is proposed that jointly optimizes model parameters and individual sparse sample weights via alternating minimization with majorize-minimize approximations, with proven convergence and demonstrated effectiveness across various learning tasks.
